judgement_units: returned fact or rejected candidate fact

semantic_statuses.issue_observed: A concrete text-level fidelity or scope issue is identified; still preliminary, not a human-confirmed gold label.
semantic_statuses.uncertain_only: No definite error assigned; subject, source, time or scope remains unresolved.
semantic_statuses.no_obvious_issue: No concrete issue found in this review; not a proof of correctness.

rules: Treat the original memory as the splitting target, not as a claim already verified in the world.
Do not silently correct old memory using source_context.
Distinguish semantic subject from original speaker; assistant utterance may discuss a user, but is not direct user testimony.
Do not treat every inferred user subject as fabricated: direct first-person source plus a reliable same-event/shared-subject link can support it.
Check supports against its declared quote and necessary context; distinguish literal quote support, reasonable paraphrase, source-attribution overstatement, and unresolved reference.
Extra details present only inside a verbatim quote do not automatically count as facts added to raw/contextualized output.
Negative preference is not the same as abstinence or never doing the activity.
A disjunction is not two separate positive assertions; preserve planning and possibility scopes.
Preserve relative time without turning utterance timestamps into event dates.
Do not infer real names, relationships or truth where the input cannot determine them.
A rejected candidate can be reviewed but must remain labelled rejected and excluded from validated-result counts.

counting_policy.format_pass_count: Number of cases accepted by the unchanged existing validator; independent quote diagnostics for a rejected case do not override failure.
counting_policy.semantic_human_review_total: Every reviewed semantic judgement remains preliminary and awaits final human confirmation.
counting_policy.unresolved_case_count: Cases containing at least one specifically identified unresolved item, separate from all-preliminary status.
counting_policy.issue_case_count: Cases with at least one observed text-level issue; uncertainty alone is not counted as an error.
counting_policy.issue_type_counts: Count distinct cases and distinct returned facts exhibiting each type; one fact may have multiple types.

model_input_exclusion: This protocol, post-hoc review findings and selection reasons are not sent to the real model.
